# Football Notes

Football Notes tints editor surfaces, sidebars, tabs, links, tags, checkboxes, tables, code blocks and callouts with a football-inspired palette while its recorded description says reading contrast stays calm in light and dark modes. Country-inspired team colorways are selected through the Style Settings plugin, or the default Football Classic palette is kept.

![Football Notes screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fyaic/Football-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Football Notes"
    author: "Rosetta Zidian Guo"
    repo:   "fyaic/Football-Obsidian-Theme"
    slug:   "football-notes"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/football-notes"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/fyaic/Football-Obsidian-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fyaic/Football-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "A football-inspired palette that tints editor surfaces, sidebars, tabs, links, tags, checkboxes, tables, code blocks and callouts while preserving calm reading contrast in light and dark modes. Switch to country-inspired team colorways via the Style Settings plugin or keep the default Football Classic palette."
}
```
